title: Sunburst Panel Upholstered Kids Bed – Children's Bed Frame
descriptionHtml:
The Sunburst Panel Kids Bed takes our sunburst fan panel shape and sizes it for a child's bed. Padded panels radiate out from a central point for a striking, fully upholstered headboard, handmade to order in Dewsbury.

Key features

  • Sunburst headboard with padded panels radiating from a central point
  • Fully upholstered enclosed side panels and matching footboard
  • Solid, sturdy frame
  • Handmade to order in West Yorkshire, UK

Sizes and prices

Single (3FT) £299.00; Small Double (4FT) £299.00; Kids Single (2.6FT) £299.00. Not sure which size you need? See our bed sizes guide.

Materials & build

Handmade to order in our own workshop in Dewsbury, West Yorkshire, on a solid wood frame that is fully upholstered. Available in a wide range of colours including Cream, Silver, Grey, Steel, Beige, Red, Green, White, Black, Blue, Pink and Brown, in fabrics such as Plush Velvet and Chenille. Bespoke requests are welcome, and free fabric swatches are available.

Mattress

Browse our mattresses, such as the 3000 Pocket Sprung Mattress. If you are unsure which mattress suits your size, especially the Kids Single (2.6FT), call 07417 439197 before you order.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Delivery is free across Great Britain (England, Scotland and Wales), made by our own team, and usually takes 3-5 working days. Northern Ireland delivery is £90. You have 14 days to return an unused, unassembled item in its original packaging, with free collection. A faulty item is replaced or fully refunded. Every bed has a 5-year frame warranty. Pay in instalments with Klarna or Clearpay at checkout. Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon-Fri, 9am-6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.

Frequently asked questions

How does the Sunburst differ from the Shell Panel Kids Bed?

The Sunburst radiates from a central point and is the bolder design. The Shell Panel Kids bed is a softer, layered alternative.

Does it have a footboard?

Yes. It has fully upholstered enclosed side panels and a matching footboard.

What sizes does it come in?

Single (3FT), Small Double (4FT) and Kids Single (2.6FT), all at £299.00.

How long does delivery take?

Delivery is free across Great Britain and usually takes 3-5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90.

Can I return it if it is not right?

Yes. Returns are free within 14 days if it is unused and unassembled in its original packaging, and faulty items are replaced or refunded in full.
